fileTitle: File:Late 2000s Buffalo RUF2 E 4GB USB 2 flash drive made in Taiwan.jpg
creator: R. Henrik Nilsson
alt: A historical Buffalo USB flash drive
description: Buffalo RUF2-E 4 GB USB 2.0 flash drive, made in Taiwan, probably dating from the late 2000s. The device has a translucent dark plastic housing through which some of the internal electronic components are visible, and a removable protective cap covering the USB connector. The flash drive is marked "BUFFALO", "USB2.0 Flash Drive", "RUF2-E", "N32", "Z068", "Made in Taiwan", "FC", "CE" and "G". A Phison-branded integrated circuit is visible through the housing. The storage capacity is 4 GB. The device measures approximately 73 × 18 × 8 mm with its cap attached and weighs approximately 9 g. The RUF2-E series was introduced by the Japanese computer peripherals manufacturer Buffalo in June 2006. A contemporary product announcement dated 21 June 2006 lists a 4 GB version of the series, with dimensions of 73 × 18 × 9 mm and a weight of approximately 10 g, closely matching this specimen. The exact manufacturing year of this particular flash drive is unknown.
caption: Historical USB flash-drive photograph illustrating persistent storage; no current transfer-speed performance is inferred from the image.
